a: A 58-hour wizarding-themed techfest held at JIS University, Kolkata. Four tracks run in parallel — Hackathon, Competitive Programming, Gaming Arena, and Hardware Hack — each inspired by a Hogwarts house. Think code, chaos, and conjuring under one roof.

Any witch, wizard, or muggle with a wand (laptop) and curiosity. Students from any college, any year, any department are welcome. You don't need prior hackathon experience — just the will to build something magical.

Teams of 2–4 for the Hackathon track. Solo for CP. Gaming depends on the title (solo or squad). Hardware teams of 2–4. You can form teams beforehand or find teammates at the Sorting Ceremony on Day 1.
The owls deliver acceptance letters free of charge. Registration is completely free. We believe magic should never be gated behind gold.
Bring your laptop, charger, ID card, and anything else you need to survive the storm. For a complete list, check out → What to Carry Into the Falls

q: Will food and accommodation be provided?
a: Absolutely! Everything is on us—food, beverages, and coffee to keep you powered through the night. Accommodation will be dorm-style, with mattresses in shared spaces—standard hacker temple vibes.
Nope! Come comfy, come casual. Bonus points if you dress like someone straight out of Gravity Falls—or bring something eerie.

Innovation, technical complexity, design & UX, real-world impact, and presentation. The council of judges values bold ideas over polished demos. A beautifully broken prototype beats a boring working one.

q: I want to change a team member. Is that possible?
a: No. Once the team has been submitted and finalized, no alterations are allowed. Please make sure your team details are accurate at the time of submission.

q: Can I participate in multiple tracks?
a: You may enter one primary track (Hackathon, CP, or Hardware) plus the Gaming Arena on the side. Gaming sessions are scheduled so they don't fully overlap with the main tracks. Choose wisely — a wand stretched too thin snaps.

q: I'm not a coder. Can I still join?
a: Absolutely. Designers, storytellers, hardware tinkerers, gamers, project managers — every order needs more than just spellcasters. The best teams are cross-disciplinary. If you can contribute, you belong.

q: I have more questions. Where can I reach out?
a: Reach out via the HexaFalls Discord Server — just go to the server and raise a ticket, and our team of watchers will guide you through the void. Or email us at 📩 support@hexafalls.org — we're always listening in the shadows... 👁️
